exposure: gestational weight gain (GWG) adherence to IOM recommendations
cohort: The study included 132 singleton pregnancies after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) in Brazil.
finding: Gestational weight gain (GWG) below recommendations was associated with prematurity and small for gestational age (SGA) offspring, while parenteral iron prescription was identified as a protective factor for SGA.
